#############################Fig.2 & Fig.S9_Beta_dispersion##########################

library(vegan)
library(betapart)
library(agricolae)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ggtext)  # itablic for subtitle
library(Cairo)  # output pdf with correct chisquare

### 1. AMF-Bray
rm(list=ls())
setwd("E:/Saline-alkali soil/Saline-alkali/amplicon/result-U/AMF/otu")

# Reading OTU table
otu_all0 <- read.csv("otu_amfFlattening.csv",check.names = F,row.names = 1,header = T)
otu_all0 <- as.data.frame(t(otu_all0))

# Read metadata file
group0 <- read.csv("sample_metadata.csv",header = T)
group0 <- na.omit(group0)
group <- group0[order(group0$sample.id),]
otu_all0$sample.id <- rownames(otu_all0)
identical(otu_all0$sample.id,group$sample.id)
otu_all <- merge(otu_all0,group,by= "sample.id")

dis <- vegdist(decostand(otu_all[,2:671],"hellinger"), method = 'bray')
mod <- betadisper(d = dis, group = factor(otu_all$plants), type = 'centroid')

#mod
#print(anova(mod));TukeyHSD(mod);TukeyHSD(mod)

p <- adonis2(dis~otu_all$plants)
print(p)

# (1) old betadispersion
plotcol <- c('red','orange',"#20B2AA",'blue',"#581845")

#pdf("E:/Saline-alkali soil/Saline-alkali/amplicon/result-U/AMF/otu/Betadisper/AMF-Betadisper-PCoA.pdf",height = 4,width=4)
mar=c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5)

plot(mod, col=plotcol,hull = FALSE,cex = 1,label.cex = 0.6,
     main="",xlab="PC1", ylab="PC2",sub="Bray",seg.col=plotcol)
title(paste0("AMF-Betadispersion"),cex =0.8, font =2,line = 2)
mtext(side = 3, sprintf("Adonis: F = %.3g; P = %.3g", p$F[1],p$`Pr(>F)`[1]), 
      col="red", cex =0.6, font =2,line = 0.8)
mtext(side = 3, sprintf("Betadisper: F = %.3g; P = %.3g",anova(mod)$`F value`[1], anova(mod)$`Pr(>F)`[1]), 
      col="red", cex =0.6, font =2,line = 0)

## dev.off()

# (2) new betadispersion & PCoA
df <- data.frame(mod$distances,mod$group)

# Nonparametric test
ST <- kruskal(mod$distances,mod$group, p.adj = "fdr")

# Extracting Chi square value and P value from the result
statis <- as.data.frame(rbind(ST$statistics[,1:2]))

# Creating dataframe for Chi square value and P value
# Sprintf for pasting texts and values
# asterisk (*) among elements represent pasting without space, tilde (~) among elements represent pasting witht space
rp.value <- ifelse(statis$p.chisq < 0.001, 
                   sprintf("italic(P) == %.2f %%*%% 10^%.0f ~ (italic(chi^2) == %.3g)", 
                           statis$p.chisq / 10^floor(log10(statis$p.chisq)), 
                           floor(log10(statis$p.chisq)), 
                           statis$Chisq),
                   sprintf("italic(P) == %.3g ~ (italic(chi^2) == %.3g)", statis$p.chisq, statis$Chisq))

# Extracting multiple comparision result
statis1 <- as.data.frame(rbind(ST$groups))
# Extracting mean of Nonparametric tests
statis2 <- as.data.frame(rbind(ST$means))

# Extracting Ymax for add letters of multiple comparision??
p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(y=mod.distances, x = factor(mod.group))) +
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width=0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5)
ymaxdata <- layer_data(p1) 
statis2$ymax <- ymaxdata$ymax

# Merging dataframe of multiple comparision result with dataframe of mean of nonparametric tests
statis1$id <- rownames(statis1)
statis2$id <- rownames(statis2)
statis2 <- merge(statis2, statis1, by = "id")

# Creating dataframe of geom_text for letters of nonparametric tests
multcomp.data <- data.frame(
  abc = factor(statis2$groups),
  x     = statis2$id,
  y     = as.numeric(statis2$ymax))

# Plot
df$mod.group <- factor(df$mod.group, levels = c("Bare land","Suaeda","Tamarix chinensis","Cotton","Maize"))
p2_amf <- ggplot(df, aes(y=mod.distances, x = mod.group, color = mod.group)) +
          stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width=0.3) +
          geom_boxplot(width = 0.5) +
          #geom_jitter(size = 0.8) +
          labs(x = "Habitat", y= "Distance to centroid", title = "AM Fungi-Beta diversity") +
          scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
                                      'Bare land' = "Bareland", 
                                      'Cotton' = "Cotton", 
                                      'Maize' = "Maize", 
                                      'Suaeda' = "Suaeda",
                                      'Tamarix chinensis' = "Tamarix")) +
          scale_color_manual(name = "Habitat", 
                             values = c("red","blue","purple","darkgreen","deepskyblue"),
                             labels = c( "Bare land"="Bareland", 
                                         "Suaeda"="Suaeda",
                                         "Tamarix chinensis"="Tamarix",
                                         "Cotton", 
                                         "Maize")) + 
          annotate("text",x=3, y=0.342, label=rp.value, col = "red", size = 5, parse=TRUE) + 
          geom_text(data = multcomp.data, aes(x = x,y = y+0.015,label=abc),
                    color = "black",
                    size = 6, hjust = 0.5) +
          theme_bw() +
          ylim(0.22,0.35) +
          theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), 
                axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black",linewidth = 0.5)) +
          theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "bold"),
                axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
                axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
                legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black", hjust=0),
                legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"))
p2_amf


# Boxplot for betadispersion
newplot <- function(title, path){   
  
  pcoa_exp <- mod$eig/sum(mod$eig) 
  df1 <- data.frame(PCo1=mod$vectors[,1], PCo2=mod$vectors[,2], Habitat=mod$group)
  centroid1 <- aggregate(df1$PCo1~df1$Habitat,FUN="mean")
  centroid2 <- aggregate(df1$PCo2~df1$Habitat,FUN="mean")
  
  centroid <- merge(centroid1,centroid2,by="df1$Habitat")
  names(centroid) <- c("Habitat","PCo1","PCo2")
  
  subtitle_text <- ifelse((p$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.001) & (ST$statistics[2] < 0.001), 
    paste(
    sprintf("Adonis: *F* = %.3g; *P* = %.3e", p$F[1], p$`Pr(>F)`[1]),
    sprintf("Betadispersion: <span style='font-family:\"Times New Roman\";'>*χ²*</span> = %.3g; *P* = %.3e", ST$statistics[1], ST$statistics[2]),
    sep = "<br>"),
    ifelse((p$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.001) & (ST$statistics[2] >= 0.001), 
           paste(
      sprintf("Adonis: *F* = %.3g; *P* = %.3e", p$F[1], p$`Pr(>F)`[1]),
      sprintf("Betadispersion: <span style='font-family:\"Times New Roman\";'>*χ²*</span> = %.3g; *P* = %.3g", ST$statistics[1], ST$statistics[2]),
      sep = "<br>"),
      ifelse((p$`Pr(>F)`[1] >= 0.001) & (ST$statistics[2] < 0.001), 
             paste(
        sprintf("Adonis: *F* = %.3g; *P* = %.3g", p$F[1], p$`Pr(>F)`[1]),
        sprintf("Betadispersion: <span style='font-family:\"Times New Roman\";'>*χ²*</span> = %.3g; *P* = %.3e", ST$statistics[1], ST$statistics[2]),
        sep = "<br>"),
              paste(
          sprintf("Adonis: *F* = %.3g; *P* = %.3g", p$F[1], p$`Pr(>F)`[1]),
          sprintf("Betadispersion: <span style='font-family:\"Times New Roman\";'>*χ²*</span> = %.3g; *P* = %.3g", ST$statistics[1], ST$statistics[2]),
          sep = "<br>")
        )
      )
    )
  
  p3 <<- ggplot(df1, aes(PCo1,PCo2,color = factor(Habitat,levels = c("Bare land","Suaeda","Tamarix chinensis","Cotton","Maize")))) +
    geom_point(size = 5, alpha=0.5) +
    geom_segment(data = merge(df1, centroid, by = "Habitat"), 
                 aes(x = PCo1.x, y = PCo2.x, xend = PCo1.y, yend = PCo2.y),alpha=0.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      name = "Habitat",
      label = c(
        'Bare land'='Bareland',
        'Cotton'='Cotton',
        'Maize'='Maize',
        'Suaeda'='Suaeda',
        'Tamarix chinensis'='Tamarix'), 
      values = c("red","blue","purple","darkgreen","deepskyblue"),
      guide=guide_legend(override.aes=list(shape = 16))) +
    labs(title = title,subtitle = subtitle_text,x=paste0("PCo1 (",round(pcoa_exp[1],3)*100, "%)" ), y=paste0("PCo2 (",round(pcoa_exp[2],3)*100, "%)" )) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_markdown(size = 13, hjust = 0.5, color = "red"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold",hjust = 0.5), 
      legend.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      legend.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 15, face = "bold"))
  
  print(p3)
  #ggsave(path, p2, height = 4,width=6)
}

# (3) boxplot of  betadispersion

     main="",xlab="PC1", ylab="PC2",sub="Bray",seg.col=plotcol)

mtext(side = 3, sprintf("Adonis: F = %.3g; P = %.3g", p$F[1],p$`Pr(>F)`[1]), 
      col="red", cex =0.6, font =2,line = 0.8)
mtext(side = 3, sprintf("Betadisper: F = %.3g; P = %.3g",anova(mod)$`F value`[1], anova(mod)$`Pr(>F)`[1]), 
      col="red", cex =0.6, font =2,line = 0)

# dev.off()

# (2) new betadispersion
df <- data.frame(mod$distances,mod$group)

ST <- kruskal(mod$distances,mod$group, p.adj = "fdr")

statis <- as.data.frame(rbind(ST$statistics[,1:2]))

rp.value <- ifelse(statis$p.chisq < 0.001, 
                   sprintf("italic(P) == %.2f %%*%% 10^%.0f ~ (italic(chi^2) == %.3g)", 
                           statis$p.chisq / 10^floor(log10(statis$p.chisq)), 
                           floor(log10(statis$p.chisq)), 
                           statis$Chisq),
                   sprintf("italic(P) == %.3g ~ (italic(chi^2) == %.3g)", statis$p.chisq, statis$Chisq))

statis1 <- as.data.frame(rbind(ST$groups))
statis2 <- as.data.frame(rbind(ST$means))

p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(y=mod.distances, x = factor(mod.group))) +
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width=0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5)
ymaxdata <- layer_data(p1) 
statis2$ymax <- ymaxdata$ymax

statis1$id <- rownames(statis1)
statis2$id <- rownames(statis2)
statis2 <- merge(statis2, statis1, by = "id")

multcomp.data <- data.frame(
  abc = factor(statis2$groups),
  x     = statis2$id,
  y     = as.numeric(statis2$ymax))

df$mod.group <- factor(df$mod.group, levels = c("Bare land","Suaeda","Tamarix chinensis","Cotton","Maize"))
p2_prot <-  ggplot(df, aes(y=mod.distances, x = mod.group, color = mod.group)) +
            stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width=0.3) +
            geom_boxplot(width = 0.5) +
            #geom_jitter(size = 0.8) +
            labs(x = "Habitat", y= "Distance to centroid", title = "Protists-Beta diversity") +
            scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
                                        'Bare land' = "Bareland", 
                                        'Cotton' = "Cotton", 
                                        'Maize' = "Maize", 
                                        'Suaeda' = "Suaeda",
                                        'Tamarix chinensis' = "Tamarix")) +
            scale_color_manual(name = "Habitat", 
                               values = c("red","blue","purple","darkgreen","deepskyblue"),
                               labels = c( "Bare land"="Bareland", 
                                           "Suaeda"="Suaeda",
                                           "Tamarix chinensis"="Tamarix",
                                           "Cotton", 
                                           "Maize")) + 
            annotate("text",x=3, y=0.455, label=rp.value, col = "red", size = 5, parse=TRUE) + 
            geom_text(data = multcomp.data, aes(x = x,y = y+0.035,label=abc),
                      color = "black",
                      size = 6, hjust = 0.5) +
            theme_bw() +
            ylim(0.25,0.47) +
            theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), 
                  axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black",linewidth = 0.5)) +
            theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "bold"),
                  axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
                  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
                  legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black", hjust=0),
                  legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"))
p2_prot


# (3) boxplot of betadispersion
newplot("Protists-Beta diversity","E:/Saline-alkali soil/Saline-alkali/amplicon/result-U/Protist/otu/Betadisper/Protist-Betadispersion-PCoA-new.pdf")
